post_text:
Day 14/30 — Pattern Matching on Spans (.NET & C#)

C# 15 and .NET 11 finally allow constant pattern matching directly on ReadOnlySpan<byte> against UTF-8 literals.

• **Zero Transcoding:** Avoids converting network byte slices into temporary strings just to switch on protocol headers.
• **Zero Gen0 Garbage:** Completely bypasses string allocations on high-throughput socket read paths.
• **Compiler Jump Tables:** Emits vectorized comparisons and jump tables directly across constant byte spans.

Watch out: Case-insensitive comparisons still require custom slicing or normalizer spans before switching.

Where are you still transcoding UTF-8 bytes to strings in your hot path?
